text.content:
Classification: Low Clan

Known to Europeans as Saracens, assassins and diablerists, the Assamites call themselves the Children of Haqim and rule as lords of the night throughout the Levant and Outremer. They trace their lineage to ancient Persia and Haqim's laws: honor the eldest, protect mortals from the schemes of other Cainites, and judge (and punish) those found lacking. The clan is divided into three castes — warriors, sorcerers, and viziers — each following Haqim's laws differently, and further divided by faith (mostly Islam, with Christian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian minorities). Assamites grow darker-skinned, not paler, with age, and their eldest, the "Old Man of the Mountain," dwells at Alamut.

Disciplines: Warriors — Celerity, Obfuscate, Quietus. Sorcerers — Auspex, Quietus, Thaumaturgy. Viziers — Auspex, Celerity, Quietus.

Advantage: All Assamites gain one Melee and one Brawl Ability at no cost.

Disadvantage: Assamites hunger for vampiric vitae. After tasting a particular vampire's blood, the player must pass a Self-Control/Instinct Test (difficulty 4 Traits) or become addicted to it; on later encountering that Kindred they must test again or frenzy, attempting to devour them.

Organization: A caste-based hierarchy centered on Alamut, associated primarily with Islam and Muslim rulers, at war with the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.522046f606404b2b]{Baali} who infiltrated their ranks in the past.

Suggested Viae: Heaven, Humanity, Kings. Traditionalists follow the Road of Blood.
